quest.title: Bring back Mr. Page's space books

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Good morning! Welcome back to my <color=red>library</color>.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Tonight the whole camp is going <color=red>stargazing</color>, so everybody has gone space-mad!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: They've borrowed every book about <color=red>planets</color>, rockets and stars. Not one has come back.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: My shelves are as empty as <color=red>outer space</color>!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Old Barnaby, Tilly and Gus could each use a hand today. Would you go and <color=red>visit</color> them?

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Help all three, and I'm sure my books will come zooming back like a <color=red>comet</color>.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: My space shelves are still full of <color=red>gaps</color>, I'm afraid.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: Keep helping Barnaby, Tilly and Gus, then come back and <color=red>report</color> to Mission Control. That's me!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Great galaxies! Every shelf is <color=red>packed</color> again!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: You helped Barnaby, Tilly and Gus, and every space book has <color=red>landed</color> safely.

afterLines.speaker: Mr. Page
afterLines.text: The library is full of space books, and I'm <color=red>over the moon</color>! Come and explore whenever you like.
